context: A chef and barista plan a tournament-themed cafe day
purpose: Teach: オール/まき/捧げ/未熟/ルイ/聴衆/準決勝/脱線

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、準決勝の応援デー、店でフェアやらん?
lines.en: Aoi-san, what if we did a fair at your shop for the semi-final cheering day?
lines.style: Enthusiastic and warm, slight Kansai lilt. Leaning forward with genuine interest. Opening fast and bright. The kind of suggestion he's already half-decided will happen.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいですね。観戦の聴衆向けに、特別メニュー、捧げる気持ちで作ります。
lines.en: That sounds nice. I'll make a special menu for the crowd watching — with the spirit of giving something back.
lines.style: Gentle agreement, a little lifted. Thoughtful pause before 'special menu' — she's already picturing it. Soft warmth, not performing. Voice settles warm at the end.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 店内BGM、ボートのオール漕ぎ動画と連動させよか。
lines.en: We could sync the shop BGM to rowing videos — the oar-strokes, you know?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but clever. The tone of someone dropping a detail he's already thought through. Quick, practical energy. Slight conspiratorial warmth — he knows she'll get it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うちのバリスタ、まだ未熟ですけど、一生懸命淹れます。
lines.en: Our barista's still learning, but they'll pour their heart into every cup.
lines.style: Bright but honest. A small self-aware smile in the voice — she knows the limitation and doesn't hide it, but frames it as earnestness instead. Genuine pride underneath.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: まきの薪で焼くパン、香りで集客できる。
lines.en: The bread baked in firewood — that smell alone will bring people in.
lines.style: Practical and assured. Forward-moving energy. He's not asking, he's stating what he knows will work. Slight satisfied weight on 'aroma.' The voice of someone who's already seen it work.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 仏人客のルイ様、毎週いらっしゃるので、特別席用意します。
lines.en: Louis comes in every week — I'll make sure we have a special seat ready for him.
lines.style: Warm and attentive. The voice of someone who notices and remembers. Slight tenderness when she says his name. Planning ahead with quiet care, not making a fuss about it.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 打ち合わせ、脱線せんようにせなな。
lines.en: But we've got to keep this meeting on track — no getting sidetracked.
lines.style: Wry, knowing humor. Gentle warning wrapped in affection. A little self-deprecating — he's admitting they both tend to drift. Light touch, not scolding. Trails off with a slight grin in the voice.
